'''Baked potato halves''' is a simple potato dish made without peeling the potatoes.

==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:Potato|Potatoes]]
*[[Cookbook:Lard|Lard]] or another [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|fat]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]

==Procedure==

# Select potatoes of similar size—around 250 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] each.
# Wash potatoes well and cut out any bad parts. Do not peel.
# Cut every potato in two halves, in the direction that will produce the thinnest halves.
# Put ¼ to ½ [[Cookbook:tsp|tsp]] of salt onto the flat side of one half, and rub both halves together, so that they are both salted.
# Place the potatoes onto a greased pan, flat side down, and into the oven preheated to 220°C. The potatoes should be baked after 45 minutes. The flat sides should form a tasty orange crust.
# Serve hot. The potatoes can be peeled by hand while eating or eaten unpeeled.
